inputs: closed data-only facts in the declared scalar, named Entity/Value Object/Enum, optional, list, set and sum types; exact UInt64 inputs normalize to bigint; all formal arguments are required, optional data fields may be absent
named_semantics: checked declarations retain selectors, identity, properties and cardinality; Entity keys use identity while validating all state; Value Object keys use all fields; no construction, invariant execution, provider ownership claim or reference lookup
composition: static specialized normalizers and native typed direct expressions, not a runtime schema or expression interpreter; recursively copied immutable values
equality: typed keys distinguish scalar types, named selectors, absent versus present, sum tags and payloads; list order and occurrences retained; set input duplicates reject after typed normalization
projection: ontology property selectors lower to their checked declared property names; list projection retains occurrences; set projection forms the duplicate-free image under the projected field's equality; no optional traversal or implicit unwrapping
operators: all, any, not, eq, lt over String/UInt64, contains, set_equal, exists, exactly_one, unique with identical-path keys, explicit list to_set and declared rule_ref; checked payload-free Enum variants
compatibility: Rule v1-v7 and factory v1-v11 unchanged; v8 is explicit and old unsupported paths remain rejecting; legacy runtime is not reinterpreted
factory_boundary: explicit successor selection projects normalized owned fields into data-only Rule facts; no raw snapshot reinterpretation, hidden Rule execution or automatic whole-factory parameter binding
